end.summary:
Recognised equal parts in watermelon and flag examples.
Named halves, thirds and quarters in some shape questions.
Solved one-third of 9 as 3 by dividing 9 into 3 equal groups.
Mixed up the denominator with parts left or not eaten; this remained at the end.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Asha practised fractions as equal shares, including identifying equal parts and finding one-third of a collection. Nisha used the method of dividing 9 into 3 equal groups to find one-third of 9, and explained why equal-sized pieces are needed. They mixed up the denominator with the parts left or not eaten, and this was not corrected by the end. At home, share snacks or paper shapes into equal groups and ask, “How many equal parts make the whole?”
